description: Quest Diagnostics works across the healthcare ecosystem to create a healthier world, one life at a time, providing diagnostic insights from the results of its laboratory testing to empower people, physicians and organizations to take action to improve health outcomes. Derived from one of the world's largest databases of de-identifiable clinical lab results, its diagnostic insights reveal new avenues to identify and treat disease, inspire healthy behaviors and improve healthcare management, and in the right hands and with the right context they can inspire actions that transform lives. The patients it serves annually comprise approximately one-third of the adult population of the United States, and over a three-year period it serves approximately one-half of the adult population of the United States, estimating that annually it serves approximately half of the physicians and half of the hospitals in the United States.
